coding.title: 1. Sum of First N Natural Numbers - edited by jegadeesh
coding.description:
Read an integer N from input and print the sum of the first N natural numbers (1+2+...+N).

Example: Input 5 -> Output 15

coding.title: 2. Prime Number Check
coding.description:
Read an integer N and print "Prime" if it is a prime number, otherwise print "Not Prime".

Example: Input 7 -> Output Prime

coding.title: 3. Reverse a String
coding.description:
Read a single word/string and print it reversed.

Example: Input hello -> Output olleh

coding.title: 4. Factorial Using Recursion
coding.description:
Read an integer N and print its factorial using a recursive method.

Example: Input 5 -> Output 120

coding.title: 5. Sort an Array
coding.description:
Read an integer N, then N integers. Print them sorted in ascending order, space-separated on one line.

Example: Input 5 / 9 3 7 1 5 -> Output 1 3 5 7 9

coding.title: 6. Average and Grade (OOP)
coding.description:
Read 3 integer marks. Print two lines:
Average: <average, 1 decimal place>
Grade: <A if avg>=90, B if avg>=75, C if avg>=60, D otherwise>

Example: Input 90 85 95 -> Output:
Average: 90.0
Grade: A
